examples.name: Sample — a redaction bar inside a sentence
paragraphs: One black bar where the appellant's name was, between filed by and , against the response of the. The bold case number and council name on either side are printed and kept.

snippets.text: HAVING SEEN the electronic file formed on account of the appeal for review **04871/OTAIP/AR/2018** filed by [REDACTED] , against the response of the **Municipal Council of Puente Alvara**, the following resolution is hereby issued.

examples.name: Sample — a redaction bar inside a transcript line
paragraphs: Line 4: Was ████ paying that before? — one black bar in the middle of a question, the rest of the page untouched. The transcript lines follow Transcript Pages§6.11.

examples.name: Sample — a redaction that prints its exemption code
paragraphs: Under Cybercrime, a dashed box the height of eight bullets prints only (b)(5); the eight bullet glyphs remain in the margin, their text gone. The code and the surviving bullets are both content the page prints: the eight bullets stay as eight list items, and the code appears once, inside the marker, at the start of the redacted span.
